headline: Bring AirNow readings into Home Assistant
intro: Connect to the AirNow web service for air quality data at a selected location. Add an AirNow API key and choose a location on the map; it defaults to your Home Assistant home location.
highlights: Get air quality data for your location from the AirNow web service
Provide an AirNow API key and choose a location on the map, with your Home Assistant home location as the default
Home Assistant polls the AirNow API every 30 minutes

flow.title: From AirNow to a local reading
stages: Generate an API key on AirNow Developer Tools
Add AirNow from Settings → Devices & services
Enter the API key and select a location on the map
